speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand your infant is experiencing bilious vomiting, an inability to pass meconium, and abdominal distension. To help me determine the cause, can you tell me exactly how old the baby is in hours or days?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-day-old male infant. The infant was born via a home birth without complications. The mother reports that the infant has had bilious vomiting and has not been able to pass meconium since birth. She also notes that the infant's abdomen appears distended.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung disease.

This diagnosis is based on the infant being 2 days old, the failure to pass meconium within the first 48 hours, bilious vomiting, and abdominal distension. I am requesting an abdominal X-ray to confirm the presence of a distal obstruction.
